title: Guide
description: How to use DVI Portal, plus answers to common questions.

account.title: One company account
account.body: Services marked “Company account” open right away, since you’re already signed in to the portal.

search.title: Search and go
search.body: Type a service name or feature in the search box at the top. Press / to jump straight to it.

favorite.title: Star your favorites
favorite.body: Tap the star on a card to add it to favorites. Favorites appear first in the list.

contact.title: IT support
contact.body: For account, access, or outage issues, reach out below. We reply in order during business hours.
